observation: Independently green city roots collided during integrated collection.
hypothesis: Same-named modules are imported globally until package boundaries exist.
recommended_action: Run a narrow collect-only integration gate before the unchanged full suite.

observation: A city scenario used RAIN while the UI catalog and closed enum used FLOOD-only vocabulary.
hypothesis: Lane-local tests did not compare UI identifiers against the shared runtime.
recommended_action: Assert UI source IDs, scenario IDs, and hazard types against the shared city-pack runtime before packaging.

observation: The same private-plan capability returned HTTP 403 for ruleset and branch-protection attempts in the human-reviewed prior run.
hypothesis: Retrying unchanged APIs cannot create the missing plan capability and only consumes the repair budget.
recommended_action: Do not retry until capability changes; use the explicitly limited local pre-push guard, isolated worktrees, approved branch namespaces, draft PR, Hosted CI, and human-only main merge while reporting SERVER_SIDE_BRANCH_PROTECTION=false.

observation: A stale external virtualenv launcher failed, and pytest's default base temporary directory was inaccessible after the environment was recreated.
hypothesis: External environment state and inherited temporary-directory ACLs are not repository failures.
recommended_action: Recreate an external virtualenv strictly from project metadata and use a unique external --basetemp with cacheprovider disabled; never modify tracked dependency metadata to mask the environment problem.
